phase0.gate_G46a: PARTIAL — the census formula wall - ops_total - outside reproduces 28.45 pp by construction, but the plan's per-region subtraction (region total - leaves inside it) gives 31.03 pp, not 28.45 pp; named regions alone give 33.55 pp. The gap is the mid site leaves (2.735 s) counted in ops_total but not in the named regions, and the outside plug (1.384 s) defined as wall - named regions. The plan's "other = 28.45 pp" is therefore not the sum of the per-region own times.
phase0.finding: the census outside is a plug (reference wall - measured regions), not a measured region; the sites build wall is 54.600 s, so the true outside is 2.328 s (4.34 pp) and the plug absorbs the +0.944 s sites-build overhead. The mid site leaves are 2.735 s (5.10 pp), larger than the 1.384 s plug, so the outside own time is negative. The per-region own-time subtraction is only meaningful at site granularity and does not reproduce the plan's 28.45 pp.
phase0.site_own_note: enter_union = A_enter - enter-site leaves; null_pass1 = A_null_win - A_null_pass2_loop - null_p1 leaves; null_pass2 = A_null_pass2_loop - null_p2 leaves; null_envelope = A_null_replay - A_null_win - replay leaves; outside_plug = outside - mid leaves (negative: the plug is smaller than the mid site leaves).
